name: @agrune/cli
description: Agrune CLI and local Playwright daemon.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agrune/backend run build && pnpm --filter @agrune/runtime run build && tsup && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='../runtime/dist/visual-runtime.global.js';if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,'dist/visual-runtime.global.js');fs.copyFileSync(src,'dist/bin/visual-runtime.global.js')}"
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm run build && AGRUNE_CLI_SMOKE=1 vitest run tests/daemon-smoke.spec.ts
